pi_model_definition.$comment: Isolated Pi provider/model definition for the repaired GLM-5.3 experiment (P03/P10). Copied into PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR/models.json for the V arm; baseUrl is replaced with the gateway's actual listen address at deploy time. compat overrides replicate the z.ai request format through the gateway (Pi 0.85.1: thinkingFormat zai sends thinking:{type:enabled,clear_thinking:false}; supportsReasoningEffort adds reasoning_effort; maxTokensField max_tokens). samplingParams pins temperature 0.6 with NO top_p. maxTokens 32768 matches the frozen per-request output cap; contextWindow 262144 is the client ceiling.

primary_metric: official matcher strict micro F3 within each trial, mean over three trials

thresholds.positive_rule: (F3_H >= F3_V + 5 OR (R_H >= R_V - 0.05 AND P_H >= P_V + 0.10)) AND fewer H FPs on >=4/6 repos in >=2/3 trials (strictly fewer; ties never count)
thresholds.precedence: invalid/incomplete first, then positive rule, then does-not-meet

secondary_analyses: report-policy ablations separated from the decision
greedy-matcher order sensitivity (fixed seed, labeled secondary)

failure_scoring.output_failure_after_inference: empty predictions, all scored positives FN, decoys TN; never labeled agent-authored

$comment: 1s ceiling -> outer container deadline (cap+30s grace) kills the V arm mid-run on a large repo — exercises timed_out kill, gateway attribution of in-flight requests, snapshot export, cleanup.
